verdict.line: You lose if she chains Bladesurge off a low minion into Flawless Duet for the stun-lock kill; you win if you blind her the moment she commits and poke from outside 850 range.

brief.thesis: Irelia has no ranged tool, so her entire kill threat is a two-step: Bladesurge (Q) off a minion or you to close the gap, then Flawless Duet (E) to stun and mark before she unloads. Teemo has no hard peel once she's on top of him, which is why Irelia carries both the lane and solo-kill edge (48.9% Teemo win rate over 1194 games) despite Teemo's poke being free damage at range. The matchup is decided by whether you deny the minions and auto-attacks that fuel her, not by raw stats.

theirWindow.when: Q is up and a minion near you is low
theirWindow.what: She can Bladesurge off that low-health minion to close the gap for free, and if it dies to the dash the cooldown refreshes instantly — chain enough resets and she's on you with E and full combo behind it. Keep wave minions topped up and don't stand near a dying one.

yourWindow.when: Her E (Flawless Duet) just whiffed or is down
yourWindow.what: Flawless Duet is her only stun and it's on a 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s cooldown, so once it's spent she has no way to lock you down. Step up and freely stack Toxic Shot and Blinding Dart until it's back.

powerCurve.note: R adds wall, burst peaks hard
Range and traps outscale her dueling

start.why: Highest pick rate start (73.7%, 48.7% WR); the extra sustain and mana keep you throwing Blinding Dart every time she commits Q without running dry.

boots.why: Magic penetration raises every point of Toxic Shot and Blinding Dart poke damage; you're not trying to out-kite her, you're trying to out-range her (50.1% WR, 40% pick).

core.why: Attack speed and the proc'd burst let you poke and reset Toxic Shot stacks fast from max range (52.5% WR path).
The burn punishes her for standing in extended trades, which is the only way she can actually fight you.
Cooldown reduction and magic pen keep Blinding Dart (8s base) and your mushroom wall up constantly to deny her engage lanes.

situational.when: you're ahead on items and want to burst through her Defiant Dance damage reduction
her Bladesurge healing is keeping her alive through your poke
she's committing to all-in dives and you need to kite the follow-up instead of just out-ranging it

runes.keystoneWhy: Three consecutive hits (autos plus Toxic Shot procs) apply a vulnerability debuff and burst — since she has to walk into your range to fight at all, every trade she starts gets punished harder.

summoners.why: Flash+Exhaust posts the best measured win rate for this spot (54%) even at low pick rate — Exhaust cuts her damage and attack speed the instant she lands Bladesurge, defusing the Q-into-E all-in that standard Flash+Ignite (88.3% pick) can't answer.

playing.title: Blind the dash, not the stand-still
playing.detail: Fire Blinding Dart (8s cd) the instant she commits Bladesurge or walks into Flawless Duet range. It shuts off the autos that build her Ionian Fervor stacks and removes her on-hit damage mid-combo.

playing.title: Keep the wave topped
playing.detail: Never let a minion near you sit low — she can Bladesurge off it to close distance for free and refresh the cooldown if it dies to the hit.

playing.title: Stay outside 850
playing.detail: Flawless Duet stuns and marks anyone caught between the two converging blades; being marked guarantees her next Q resets onto you. Fight from your 680 range, not hers.

playing.title: Punish her after E
playing.detail: Once Flawless Duet is on cooldown (up to 16s early) she has no stun. Walk up and freely stack poison and Blinding Dart until it's back.

playing.title: Don't walk through the R wall
playing.detail: From level 6, Vanguard's Edge leaves a wall that damages and slows anyone crossing it. Route around it when disengaging or chasing, not through it.

playing.title: Pre-place mushrooms on choke points
playing.detail: Noxious Trap has only a 1s cooldown — zone the river and jungle entrances so her Q resets into your territory cost her health and vision, not you.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner picks are measured from live games on the current patch (OP.GG); the mechanical reasoning on cooldown windows and trade timing is my own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Irelia’s Flawless Duet (E). As she will close in using Bladesurge (Q), stay away from minions low on health!
